comments.content: `isPathOnDefaultFilesystem` calls `path.getFileSystem()` twice; the second call is redundant since `pathFileSystemClass` already holds the result. Minor, but simplify to use the local variable.

`DEFAULT_FILESYSTEM_CLASS` is initialized eagerly at class-load time via `PathUtils.getDefaultFileSystem().getClass()`. This runs during static init of `PolicyManager`, which may be problematic if the default filesystem isn't yet available or if this triggers unwanted initialization. Consider making it lazy or at least confirm this is safe in all contexts where `PolicyManager` is loaded.

`String.join(",", paths)` is evaluated eagerly inside the lambda only when debug is enabled, which is fine, but note that `checkPath` and `isParent` are on hot paths for file entitlement checks. Even the lambda allocation per call can add overhead. Consider guarding with `logger.isDebugEnabled()` if this is truly hot, or remove these debug logs before merging.
